name: portfolio-case-study
context: Design a detailed case study page for a portfolio website. The audience is potential clients and hiring managers evaluating design or development work. Must showcase project context, process, deliverables, and outcomes with rich media. Target platforms: desktop and mobile responsive with emphasis on visual storytelling.
constraints: All visual values must reference Design_Token (no raw hex, px, or rem values)
Follow typography.rules.json for case study heading hierarchy and body prose
Apply color.rules.json for section dividers, pull quotes, and metric highlights
Use layout.rules.json for full-width media sections alternating with contained text
Images must include alt text and lazy loading for performance
Metric/outcome numbers should use heading scale for visual prominence
Page structure must use semantic sections with heading hierarchy

outputCriteria.format: Page layout spec with narrative sections, media blocks, and outcome metrics
qualityChecks: All color values resolve to semantic tokens
Media sections handle various aspect ratios gracefully
accessibilityRequirements: All images have descriptive alt text
Heading hierarchy is sequential without gaps
Metrics have proper text equivalents, not just large numbers
Navigation between sections via skip links
Video content includes captions or transcript link

examples.output:
Organism: OutcomeMetrics
  Layout: grid(columns: repeat(3, 1fr), gap: var(--space-xl))
  padding: var(--space-2xl) 0
  border-top: var(--border-subtle)
  Children:
    - Molecule: MetricBlock
        Layout: flex(direction: column, align: center, gap: var(--space-xs))
        Content:
          - Atom: Text(token=typography.heading.xl, color=color.primary, content='metric-value')
          - Atom: Text(token=typography.body.sm, color=color.text.secondary, content='metric-label')
        aria-label: 'metric-value metric-label'
  Responsive: 1 column on mobile, 3 columns on desktop
acceptanceCriteria: Uses semantic tokens for all styling
Metrics are screen-reader accessible with full context
Grid responds to viewport with proper breakpoints
Visual hierarchy emphasizes numbers over labels
